glossary.cvss: The industry-standard severity score, from 0 to 10. Higher means more dangerous if exploited.
glossary.epss: The estimated chance this vulnerability is exploited in the wild in the next 30 days.
glossary.slaCompliance: The share of vulnerabilities fixed before their due date. Higher is better.

controls.subtitle: Security controls the organisation runs. A risk acceptance cites them to justify a lower severity.

controls.reviewDueHint: After this date the control can't be cited until it is reviewed again.
controls.validation: Fill in the name (at least 3 characters), owner and next review date.

deployments.hint: Usually recorded by the pipeline. Only running versions count toward the backlog.
deployments.digestHint: Lets audit match the running image to its scan.
deployments.versionHint: Pick an existing version or type a new label.

evidence.hint: One file for audit: which version ran when, its scan results and every exception approved for it.
evidence.contents: Covers {{from}} – {{to}}, including the last scan of versions already running at the start.
evidence.rangeInvalid: The start date must be before the end date.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Requests to accept a risk or mark a finding as not applicable. Every one is approved by someone other than the requester.
exceptions.sectionHint: An approved exception pauses or adjusts the SLA for this issue in every version of the application.
exceptions.requestHint: Your request goes to approvers based on severity. It has no effect until approved.

typeHint.risk_acceptance: The vulnerability is real but you'll fix it later. Controls may justify a lower severity; it must end by the SLA date.
typeHint.false_positive: The scanner is wrong — the component or vulnerability isn't really there.
typeHint.not_affected: The component is present but the vulnerable code can't be exploited here.

exceptions.legacyHint: Migrated from the old waiver list; approved under the previous single-approver rule.
exceptions.emptyAwaiting: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
exceptions.coversHint: Also covers the same issue in versions scanned later.
exceptions.bypassHint: Record where DevOps let the release through, citing {{reference}}.
exceptions.withdrawHint: Withdrawing cancels your request. The finding's SLA is unchanged.
exceptions.revokeHint: Revoking ends the exception now; covered findings go back to their original severity and SLA.

form.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Approvers and audit will read this.
form.residualHint: At most two levels lower. KEV stays High or above. Needs at least one control.
form.noControls: No usable controls — ask AppSec to add one to the library.
form.evidenceHint: Links or notes that support the request.
form.expiresHint: No later than the SLA due date for the resulting severity.
form.reasonTooShort: Write a reason of at least 10 characters.
form.controlRequired: Pick at least one control to lower the severity.
